question: Who is included among special populations in community health?

options.D: Pregnant women and children under five

question: Why do special groups need targeted government interventions in public health?

options.A: They pay higher taxes to fund public health infrastructure
options.B: They face severe barriers in accessing routine healthcare services
options.C: They demand exclusive access to specialized private hospitals
options.D: They represent the majority of the active workforce in Nigeria

question: Why has government involvement in elderly care become more necessary lately?

options.C: Older persons no longer require any form of medical or nursing attention

question: Which state government organ usually runs social welfare and rehabilitation homes?

question: Why is teamwork across different sectors necessary when caring for special groups?
